description.zh:
事件内容。

>该参数的取值可以为任意一个合法的JSON，建议JSON中包含关键字值`product`、`resourceId`和`regionId`。
description.en:
The content of the system event.

> The value of this parameter is a JSON object. We recommend that you include the `product`, `resourceId`, and `regionId` fields in the JSON object.

description.zh:
事件名称。

>详细信息请参见[DescribeSystemEventMetaList](~~114972~~)。
description.en:
The name of the system event.

> For more information, see [DescribeSystemEventMetaList](~~114972~~).
The ID of the application group.

description.zh:
云服务名称。

>事件支持的云服务，详细信息请参见[云服务系统事件](~~167388~~)。
description.en:
The name of the cloud service.

> For information about the Alibaba Cloud services that are supported by CloudMonitor, see [Supported cloud services and their system events](~~167388~~).

title.zh: 调试云资源的系统事件

descriptions.zh: 本接口用于调试资源配置的触发逻辑是否符合预期，即通过调用该接口发送一条测试事件，帮助您验证对应的事件触发报警后返回的内容是否符合预期。
descriptions.en: Tests whether a system event can be triggered as expected. Simulates a system event and verifies the response when the event triggers an alert.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cms send-dry-run-system-event --product ecs --event-name Agent_Status_Stopped --group-id 123456 --event-content product_:_CloudMonitor_,_resourceId_:_acs:ecs:cn-hongkong:1736511134380000:instance/_instanceId_,_level_:_CRITICAL_,_instanceName_:_instanceName_,_regionId_:_cn-hangzhou_,_name_:_Agent_Status_Stopped_,_content_:_ipGroup_:_0.0.0.0,0.0.0.1_,_tianjimonVersion_:_1.2.11_,_status_:_stopped --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
